a3.past_the_cap: the running exchange ends at its next model call; the reminder follows with its history
a3.reminder: Please finish now by calling select_result.
a3.token_cap_basis: plan initial value, kept by owner ruling N3 (not tightened to the development p95)
a3.token_count: input + output of every main-engine turn_end and every sub-agent turn; cache hits in full; billed (uncached) input reported apart; a turn without usage refuses the unit

cosmx.source_shape: 793318 cells x 999 genes; X from layers['counts']; slide_id 1/2; FOV in donor_id
cosmx.warmup: drawn from slide 1 first (slide 1, FOV 41) and removed

estimators.D1: mean over included methods of ARI(tun_m) - ARI(def_m); fallback_default or failed tuning contributes 0
estimators.D1_sensitivity: the same with fallback_default / failed methods removed
estimators.D2: ARI(fin) - median over included methods of ARI(def_m)
estimators.D3: ARI(fin) - max over included methods of ARI(def_m)
descriptive: regret vs oracle over all arms and vs the probe only
Spearman rho of fixed-K score and ARI at the chosen K (n >= 5)
chosen K distribution, share in stable peaks vs |M|/|G|, requests, fallbacks, |K - K*|
share of skipped stage 2; source of final choices
estimators.failure: no fin -> ARI 0; sensitivity: median def
estimators.inclusion: methods whose default trial ended ok (others excluded from D1, D2, D3)
estimators.repetitions: averaged per unit before any statistic; spread reported

leak.opaque_ids: units u01.. (DLPFC), c01.. (CosMx), w01 (warm-up); batch b0
patterns: (\d+|[一二三四五六七八九十]+)\s*(个)?(层|区域|分区|区)

llm.max_tokens_behaviour: not sent; the endpoint uses the model's own output ceiling (owner ruling N4)
llm.model_date: as served by the provider on the run date; the date is recorded per call in llm/NNNN.json
llm.thinking_behaviour: none configured; the model's default reasoning is returned as reasoning_content and counted as output tokens (owner ruling N4)

measured_on_development.a0_equivalence: ARI 1.000 for all 5 methods on both units (seeded, different GPU)

panel.combination: N1: mean of members normalised by the range of the probe's ok trials with K labels; not clipped; a member with an empty range or < 2 reference trials leaves the mean. N2 (within-group ranks) was compared on the development units and not adopted.
panel.se: SE_pas = sqrt(PAS(1-PAS)/n)/E[PAS]; SE_sil = sd/sqrt(m); SE = sqrt(sum_j (SE_j/range_j)^2)/members

plan: docs/plans/0057-ensemble-tuning.md v3.1, with the owner rulings of 2026-09-27 (N1-N4)

curves.a: mean pairwise AMI; members: exact methods' probe trial at K, calibrated methods' full-input trial at K of median resolution; >= 3 partitions
curves.c: 1 - rPAC over pairs present together at least once; rPAC = PAC / (1 - prop_zeroes)
curves.f: share of subsample runs with K labels

probe.fallback_k: >= 2 curves defined; best mean rank among defined K; ties: larger a, then smaller K
probe.marker_request: once, 1-2 K of the grid not in the stable peaks; the 2 retries span both steps
probe.markers: scanpy wilcoxon on X; compact top 3 for every K, full top 5 for the stable peaks and requested K
probe.peaks: not below the neighbouring K among the K where the curve is defined; f and c only where f >= min_f
probe.subsample_preprocessing: 80% of observations; neighbour graph rebuilt from the input X_pca, PCA not recomputed

search.calibration: bisection on the log scale between the largest value below K and the smallest above; initial value from the probe's resolution map; off_k / unreachable_k not selectable
search.cross_method: highest fixed-K score among method answers with K labels
search.dimensions: active under the defaults and pins, not the K parameter, not pinned, by priority
search.no_eligible_trial: the method's default trial (fallback_default), which may not have K labels
search.proposal_checks: validate_params; pins equal; not the default, a sweep or another proposal; a refused item is dropped without a retry and topped up by random search (seed sha256(run_id|method|stage1)); an unreadable batch retries at most 2 times
search.simplicity: among eligible trials with score >= best - SE(best): fewest parameters differing from the defaults (K and pins not counted), then the smallest sum of distances |x - default|/(high - low) (log scale for log parameters; 1 for categorical/bool), then the earliest
search.skip_rule: skip stage 2 unless a stage-1 trial scores above default score + default SE
search.stage1: 3 one-parameter sweeps (2-D: both ends of priority 1, far end of priority 2; 3-D: far end of each; ties to the larger value) + 3 model proposals, run together

stage2.2-D: 4 axis points + 2 diagonals along and against default->centre
stage2.clipped_duplicates: 2 steps the other way, else dropped

seeding.a0_definition: the probe's default-parameter trial, which equals running the skill directly with its defaults in the same seed environment (verified, T10-1)

statistics.cosmx: per slide (n = 12 each); slide-stratified mean with within-slide bootstrap as description; K* = 2 blocks listed with their median
statistics.dlpfc: 10 units main; split by donor; sensitivity without Br8100
statistics.j1: share choosing K = 7 by K* (A1, A2, A6; DLPFC K*=5 group 151669-151672 vs K*=7; CosMx by K* both definitions); D1/D2 by K*; D1 given chosen K = 7; sentence required if A1's share at K*=5 >= A6's
statistics.sign_flip: exact two-sided sign-flip p (descriptive; no multiplicity correction)

stop_line: if the 95% t intervals of D1 and D2 on the DLPFC hold-out both have upper bounds < 0, do not proceed to the 0059 confirmation (t interval decides when it and BCa disagree)
technical_freeze: none (owner ruling 2026-09-27): settings are recorded in each run directory, not checked
